result:
I’d make genuine empathy unavoidable.

Not soft, optional empathy — the kind people can switch off when it’s inconvenient. I’d make it so that whenever someone has power over another person’s suffering, they feel enough of it to be unable to ignore it. Leaders, CEOs, soldiers, judges, trolls, strangers: if your choices hurt someone, you would carry a real fraction of that weight.

I think most cruelty isn’t pure evil; it’s distance. Distance from consequences, from faces, from pain. Remove that distance, and the world changes.
